pages.text: Four prizes come from bosses. You don't need to be good with a sword: every one of them can be beaten by a Create build. Machines don't miss, don't get scared and can be rebuilt.

pages.title: Tools
pages.text: $(li)$(l:industry/cannons)Big Cannons$(/l) and autocannons for range$(li)Underwater Mines and Depth Charges for the sea$(li)Potato Cannons for cheap firepower$(li)Trains, ships and subs to carry it all

pages.title: Tips
pages.text: Build from the safety of a vehicle or a bunker. Bring the build to the boss on a train, ship or submarine. Bosses do not scale with player count here, so bring a friend.
